name: Git status check
description: Read-only git status and diff summary for the current directory.
rationale: Workflow pack: inspect git repository state without committing or pushing.

args.command: if (-not (Test-Path .git)) { 'Not a git repository in the current directory.'; exit 0 }; git status --short --branch | Out-String

steps.summary: Read-only: git status for the current directory
side_effects: Runs read-only git status in PowerShell

args.command: if (-not (Test-Path .git)) { 'Skipping diff — not a git repository.'; exit 0 }; git diff --stat | Out-String

side_effects: Runs read-only git diff in PowerShell
